head: 92c163ba36e456f637479abfc08da7bfd05e095f
claim: A 10-minute dictation with short pauses and file VAD on now takes about as long as the same take with the gate off, with byte-identical text, instead of about 1.75 times as long, measured on the real whisper.cpp decoder on host cores.

steps.start: A built whisperRnEngine with file VAD on, the real whisper.cpp decoder and Silero, and a 10-minute take with short pauses
steps: Transcribe the take with the gate off
Transcribe it with the published 0.6.1 build and file VAD on
Transcribe it with this head and file VAD on, with Silero and with the energy gate
Compare time, decode count and text
Transcribe a mostly silent take and check silent windows are skipped
steps.result: This head with file VAD: Silero 53.1 s (1.05x), 24 decodes; energy 51.3 s (1.02x), 24 decodes. Text byte-identical to gate off: true. Sparse take decodes 33 of 34 gate-off windows.

verdicts.seen: Read summary.txt. Gate off 50.4 s, 24 decodes; this head with Silero 53.1 s (1.05x), 24 decodes; energy 51.3 s (1.02x), 24 decodes; published 0.6.1 was 2.07x/1.85x with 83/89 decodes. 'Text byte-identical to gate off: true', 7/7 pass. This matches the outcome (near parity, identical text, versus ~1.75x before).

Read 9 timing lines and 7 PASS checks. After pauses neural 53.1 s/24 decodes/1274 words, energy 51.3 s/24 decodes/1274 words, speech 54.6 s/24 decodes/1274 words, versus gate off 62.6 s and 50.4 s, both 24 decodes, 1274 words. Before: 104.2 s/83 decodes and 93.4 s/89 decodes. Checks include 'text byte-identical to gate off' and 'takes under 1.3x gate off'. One gate-off run was 62.6 s (likely load noise: load avg ~17-21), but the later 50.4 s run is consistent. Supports the outcome.
